lede: The most charged item this week is Wednesday's Parks & Recreation Commission meeting, where the already-approved paving of Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts comes back up — more than 400 signatures and letters opposing the project are on the table. The gondola project also gets a substantive look Tuesday when the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up funding commitments, capital investment grants, and what's described as an action item on background and history. The Town Council meets Sunday in a special session to hear a liquor-licensing request for KOTO's Live at the Drive event.
